function.name: space_star_info
function.description: Retrieve information about a particular star in the universe. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

message.content:
The largest planet that has been observed so far is the super‑Jupiter **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly 2.5 × the radius of Jupiter (about 18,000 km).  Its mass is estimated to be around 10–15 M_Jup, making it one of the most massive planets known.
